## Why This Is Asked

Evaluates expertise in designing secure, multi-tenant CI/CD architectures with strict isolation requirements, rapid incident response capabilities, and compliance with enterprise security standards.

- **Tenant Isolation**: Per-tenant artifact segregation using dedicated S3 buckets with KMS encryption and Object Lock

## Evaluation Criteria

- Understanding of multi-tenant security isolation patterns
- Knowledge of AWS native security services (KMS, Signer, CloudTrail)
- Ability to design rapid incident response automation
- Compliance-focused architecture with immutable audit trails
